title: Text and Multimodal Data Processing
summary: This module provides specialized processors and tokenizers for handling text and multimodal data. It includes components for integrating text with images, advanced text tokenization with linguistic features, and utilities for normalizing numerical text, particularly for speech applications.

nodes.label: Process Multimodal Inputs
nodes.title: ColModernVBert Processor
nodes.description: Handles multimodal input (text and images) for ColModernVBert models, preparing them for the model and computing late-interaction retrieval scores. It manages special tokens for image integration and query augmentation.

nodes.label: Prepare OCR Inputs
nodes.title: GoT-OCR2 Processor
nodes.description: Preprocesses images and text queries for GoT-OCR2 models, including handling bounding box annotations, multi-page documents, and constructing specialized prompts for OCR tasks.

nodes.label: Tokenize Text with Context
nodes.title: RoCBert Tokenizer
nodes.description: Converts raw text into token IDs for RoCBert models, incorporating additional linguistic features like word shape and pronunciation IDs for enhanced contextual understanding.

nodes.label: Normalize Numbers in Text
nodes.title: English Number Normalizer
nodes.description: Transforms numerical expressions (e.g., '123', '$50.50', '50%') in English text into their spelt-out word forms, useful for speech synthesis and other text-to-speech applications.

nodes.label: Provide Base Tokenization
nodes.title: Base Tokenizer Utility
nodes.description: Offers fundamental tokenizer functionalities such as adding special tokens, encoding/decoding text, padding, truncation, and managing chat templates, serving as a base for specialized tokenizers.

nodes.label: Raw Text Input
nodes.title: Raw Text
nodes.description: Unprocessed textual data provided as input to the module.

nodes.label: Raw Image Input
nodes.title: Raw Images
nodes.description: Unprocessed image data, potentially including bounding box information, provided as input.

nodes.label: External Image Processor
nodes.title: Image Preprocessing
nodes.description: An external utility responsible for initial image preprocessing steps before multimodal integration.

nodes.label: Vocabulary Files
nodes.title: Tokenizer Vocabularies
nodes.description: External files containing vocabulary, word shape, and pronunciation mappings required by tokenizers.

nodes.label: Model-Ready Inputs
nodes.title: Encoded Model Inputs
nodes.description: Processed and tokenized data (text, image features, special IDs) formatted for direct consumption by a machine learning model.

nodes.label: Retrieval Scores
nodes.title: Computed Retrieval Scores
nodes.description: Numerical scores indicating the relevance or similarity between queries and passages, typically used in information retrieval systems.

nodes.label: Normalized Text Output
nodes.title: Spelt-Out Numbers
nodes.description: Textual data where all numerical expressions have been converted into their natural language word forms.

nodes.label: Numerical Text Input
nodes.title: Text with Numbers
nodes.description: Textual data containing numerical expressions that require normalization.

groups.label: Multimodal Processors
groups.title: Multimodal Data Processing
groups.description: Components responsible for processing and integrating both text and image data, often for tasks like visual language understanding or OCR.

groups.label: Text Tokenization
groups.title: Text Tokenization Utilities
groups.description: Core components for converting raw text into numerical representations (tokens) suitable for model input, including specialized tokenizers and base functionalities.

groups.label: Text Normalization
groups.title: Text Preprocessing
groups.description: Utility for normalizing specific elements within text, such as converting numerical digits to their word forms for speech applications.
